title: Autonomous Coding Agent Architecture
description: Deconstructing core components, memory systems, safety guardrails, and evaluation harnesses for agentic coding assistants.

categories.name: Context & Workspace Management
aspects: Dynamic token budgeting and prompt compression strategies

Filesystem diff representation and patch conflict resolution
Incremental symbol indexing for multi-repo search

categories.name: Execution & Tool Sandboxing
aspects: Lightweight containerization vs micro-VM execution boundaries
Process timeout handling and runaway loop detection
Standard stream (stdout/stderr) buffering and truncation policies
Network isolation and whitelist security policies

categories.name: Planning & Self-Correction
aspects: Sub-goal generation and step-level backtracking algorithms
Automated linter and test feedback loop integration

categories.name: Memory & Continuous Learning
aspects: Long-term preference and architectural decision storage
Tool usage failure logging and automated few-shot adaptation
